notablePrerequisites:
Raving Dead does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents have even life totals.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Raving Dead.
Warlock Class is level three.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Raving Dead.
Raving Dead triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
